$comment: Designed permission policy for this repo. .claude/settings.local.json is REGENERATED from this file at every P5 (P5 step 5) — entries that accreted during runs are dropped. Add a permission here deliberately, or lose it at the next publish.
$deny_comment: Push is deny-by-default: P3 forbids executors pushing shared branches, and only the ORCH merges. Credential paths are deny-read so a probe run cannot leak a key into a transcript.
$allow_comment: Reads are repo-relative on purpose. The previous policy shipped Read(//Users/**): macOS-only (Linux and WSL have no /Users), and broad enough to read every other repo on the machine, which quietly defeated the credential denies below.
